Rest, for those who weary be?
Then, my soul, put in thy claim,
Sure that promise speaks to thee:
Marks of grace I cannot show,
Yet I weary am I know,
And the weary long for rest.
Newton printed the hymn under Matthew 11:28. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. MATTHEW 11:28 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ MATTHEW 11
